summary: Clean Harbors filed an 8-K disclosing a $600 million private offering of 6.250% senior notes due 2034, priced September 17, 2026, via Rule 144A and Regulation S. Proceeds finance the previously announced EnviroServe acquisition and repay revolver borrowings used partially for the ES&H acquisition. The offering is not contingent on closing either acquisition; unapplied proceeds would fund general corporate purposes. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or ownership stake was stated. Watch acquisition financing risk, note pricing versus leverage, and completion timing of both targets.
